evals.prompt: I'm staring at my quarterly VAT return and I can't get started. Break it down into ridiculously small steps that each take less than 1 minute. Give me the first step and tell me exactly where to put my hands to begin.
evals.expected_output: Only step 1 of an estimated total, a single physical action under a minute, literal hand placement, and an invitation to reply done for step 2.
expectations: Gives exactly one step and does not list the later steps
Step 1 is one physical action that takes under a minute and contains no decision
Includes literal hand placement matched to the medium the task is done on
Shows an approximate total step count
Invites the user to reply done for the next step
Has no preamble and stays under about 80 words

evals.prompt: I'm feeling understimulated. Create a 'Dopamine Menu' for me with 5-minute 'Appetizers' (quick movement), 20-minute 'Main Courses' (deep work), and 10-minute 'Sides' (creative play) to keep my brain engaged. I work from a small apartment and this week I'm writing an investment memo.
evals.expected_output: Three courses with about five concrete items each, Main Courses tied to the investment memo, a How to order sequence, and one closing line.
expectations: Has Appetizers at 5 minutes of movement, Main Courses at 20 minutes of deep work, and Sides at 10 minutes of creative play
Lists about five items per course, each concrete with a clear finish line
Appetizers need no equipment and fit a small apartment
Main Courses refer to the investment memo
Includes a How to order sequence that puts movement before deep work and never runs two Main Courses back to back
Has no preamble and ends with a single closing line

evals.prompt: Act as my virtual body double for the next 30 minutes. I'm working on clearing my inbox, about 300 unread emails. Check in with me every 10 minutes, ask for a status update, and help me stay focused. (Test setting: plain chat with no scheduling tools; the current time is 14:00.)
evals.expected_output: A one-message session start with a proposed finish line, one setup nudge, a micro-sized first move, check-in clock times, and an honest request that the user sets a timer because the assistant cannot message first.
expectations: Proposes a concrete finish line for the 30 minutes instead of asking the user to define one
Gives a micro-sized first move
States the check-ins as clock times 14:10 and 14:20 and the wrap-up as 14:30
Says plainly that it cannot message first and asks the user to set a timer and send a message when it rings
Does not promise a check-in that nothing will deliver
Includes one setup nudge such as putting the phone away
Stays short with no preamble

evals.prompt: My brain is full of open loops. Categorize these into Now, Later and Trash, and write a one-sentence Next Action Step only for the Now items. Here goes: rent is due on the 1st and I'm not sure I have enough in checking, need to reply to Mark about the contract redlines he sent Tuesday, dentist said to book a cleaning 6 months ago, what if the investor pulls out, car registration expires next month, I keep replaying that awkward thing I said at dinner, need a birthday gift for my sister (her birthday is Saturday), the kitchen tap drips, I should learn Spanish, my accountant asked for the tax documents last week, the gym membership I never use is still charging me, my laptop battery is dying fast, haven't called grandma in a month, and my chest has been feeling tight when I climb stairs.
evals.expected_output: Every loop sorted into exactly one bucket, at most five Now items each with one next-action sentence, no next actions for Later or Trash, the chest tightness in Now, and a closing offer to micro-start Now #1.
expectations: Every loop from the dump appears in exactly one bucket
Now holds at most five items
Each Now item has exactly one next-action sentence that starts with a physical verb
Later and Trash items carry no next actions
The chest tightness on stairs is in Now with a next action to contact a doctor
The rent worry is sorted as a concrete action rather than as a worry
The investor what-if and the dinner replay are in Trash
Any deadline the assistant guessed is marked with (?)
Ends with one line offering to break Now #1 into tiny steps
